#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

const int MOD = 998244353;

int mul_mod(int a, int b) {
    return (int)((ll)a * b % MOD);
}

int pow_mod(int a, int b) {
    if (a == 0) return 0;
    int res = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) res = mul_mod(res, a);
        a = mul_mod(a, a);
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    int n, k;
    ll kl;
    scanf("%d %lld", &n, &kl);
    if (kl >= n) {
        printf("0\n");
        return 0;
    }
    k = (int)kl;

    vector<int> fact(n + 1);
    vector<int> inv_fact(n + 1);
    fact[0] = fact[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        fact[i] = mul_mod(fact[i - 1], i);
    }
    inv_fact[n] = pow_mod(fact[n], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        inv_fact[i] = mul_mod(inv_fact[i + 1], i + 1);
    }

    auto comb = [&](int a, int b) -> int {
        if (b < 0 || b > a) return 0;
        return mul_mod(fact[a], mul_mod(inv_fact[b], inv_fact[a - b]));
    };

    int ans = 0;
    int mult = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n - k; ++i, mult = -mult) {
        int c = comb(n - k, i);
        int p = pow_mod(n - k - i, n);
        int add = mul_mod(mult, mul_mod(p, c));
        if (add < 0) add += MOD;
        ans = (ans + add) % MOD;
    }

    ans = mul_mod(ans, mul_mod(fact[n], mul_mod(inv_fact[k], inv_fact[n - k])));
    if (k != 0) ans = mul_mod(ans, 2);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}
